reviewAdvisory: The figure record gives 'more than 200' devices, not 200, so multiplying by 200 treats a lower bound as an exact baseline and produces a derived count the source does not support.
The 140 figure is computed from an assumed exact 200 and an assumed exact 30 percent, neither of which the figures contain, so it is a fabricated number presented in the calculation block.
The article explicitly states no landed-cost figure is computed and the only arithmetic is the unsupported 200 x 0.30 derivation, so the declared information gain does not match the content.

The 'world's first' claim is attributed to the report but no figure record or quoted definition supports it, and the draft elsewhere says the report does not itemise the 6S format, leaving the superlative unverifiable from the supplied material.
